metadata.coverage_notes: Coverage includes Fresh Beef Burgers, Fish, Chicken, Vegetarian, Gluten Free, Breakfast items, Sides, Fountain Drinks, Iced Tea, Lemonade, BV Bevies, Cold Foam, Milkshakes, Bliss Shakes, Sundaes, Kids Meals, Dipping Sauces, Cream/Toppings, Stumptown Coffee. Breakfast items available at select locations only.

Burgers.description: Fresh beef burgers, vegetarian burgers, and gluten-free options

Chicken.description: Chicken sandwiches, tenders, and chicken meals

Fish.description: Cod sandwiches and cod with chips

Breakfast.description: Breakfast burgers, sandwiches, biscuits, and burritos (select locations)

Beverages.description: Fountain drinks, iced tea, lemonade, BV Bevies, milkshakes, Bliss shakes, coffee

Sides.description: Fries, onion rings, applesauce, hash browns

Desserts.description: Sundaes with ice cream and plant-based options

Toppings.description: Cold foam, whipped cream, malt powder, and other add-ons
